_rules: This public file stays EMPTY. Keep the real list in supporters.private.json next to it: that file is git-ignored, because names in a public Git history can never be fully removed.
Only add people who asked for it themselves, for example in their PayPal note ('Show: name' or 'Show: name + amount').
Show the name exactly as they wrote it (first name or nickname is fine). Never add e-mail addresses or PayPal details.
Only fill in 'amount' if they asked to show the amount, for example "€25". Otherwise leave it out.
Remove anyone who asks, in the next update. Newest supporters first.
